### Headline summary
- Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following a scandal. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261112/p66#a261112p66), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1032774/president-donald-trump-tim-cook-nvidia-jensen-huang))
- Anthropic's IPO is reported to be six times oversubscribed, potentially making it the largest in history. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/anthropic-ipo-said-to-be-six-times-oversubscribed-video), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/bloomberg-anthropic-ipo-six-times-oversubscribed-ai), [AI Business](https://aibusiness.com/foundation-models/anthropic-ipo-tests-wall-street-s-appetite-for-frontier-ai), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/what-anthropics-s-1-says-about-agent-risk-and-who-carries-it-5b8dac31be82?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))
- Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for coding and agentic workflows. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/google-launches-gemini-4-hydrogen-for-faster-coding-and-ai-workflows), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/13/google-gemini-4-hydrogen/))

### Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia following a scandal, with reports detailing the political fallout and his departure from the company. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261112/p66#a261112p66), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1032774/president-donald-trump-tim-cook-nvidia-jensen-huang), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-13/inside-jensen-huang-s-final-hours-as-the-ceo-of-nvidia), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-13/trump-says-huang-told-him-he-regrets-scandal-s-toll-on-family))

### Anthropic IPO reported to be six times oversubscribed
Reports indicate that Anthropic's initial public offering has received demand six times the available shares, potentially making it the largest IPO in history. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/anthropic-ipo-said-to-be-six-times-oversubscribed-video), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/bloomberg-anthropic-ipo-six-times-oversubscribed-ai), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropics-ipo-is-six-times-oversubscribed-and-on-track-to-become-the-largest-public-offering-in-history/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/anthropic-ipo-ai-s-1-4t-test-video))

### Anthropic IPO filing and market reaction
Anthropic's IPO filing details agent risks and spending, with Wall Street bracing for the company's financials as the public offering tests investor appetite for standalone frontier AI. ([AI Business](https://aibusiness.com/foundation-models/anthropic-ipo-tests-wall-street-s-appetite-for-frontier-ai), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/what-anthropics-s-1-says-about-agent-risk-and-who-carries-it-5b8dac31be82?source=rss----98111c9905da---4), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/technology/anthropic-ipo-spending-plans.html))

### Microsoft 365 global outage
Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot, experienced a widespread global outage that disrupted operations for users. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/microsoft-labors-fix-long-outage-office-outlook-copilot), [Datafloq](https://datafloq.com/microsoft-365-outage-failing-server-health-checks-took-down-outlook-teams-and-copilot/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/microsoft-outage-disrupting-email-ceo-business-leaders-barely-use-it-2026-11), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/microsoft-outage-fix-fails-to-restore-outlook-teams-copilot-across-74-countries))

### Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen model
Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for coding and agentic workflows that replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash, with pricing and performance details highlighting its speed and cost efficiency. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/google-launches-gemini-4-hydrogen-for-faster-coding-and-ai-workflows), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/13/google-gemini-4-hydrogen/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/13/google-releases-gemini-4-hydrogen-in-search-and-the-gemini-app-replacing-gemini-3-8-flash/), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/spaisee/gemini-4-hydrogen-makes-ai-speed-a-question-of-total-cost-258j))

### OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases
OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a feature allowing AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users, initially available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US. ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-wallet), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-launches-chatgpt-wallet-for-agent-assisted-purchases/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261113/p15#a261113p15), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/13/chatgpts-new-wallet-lets-ai-agents-shop-and-check-out-for-you/))

### Chinese data centers found using restricted Nvidia chips
Investigations revealed that Chinese data centers and companies, including those linked to Alice Huang, have procured and installed Nvidia chips despite US export controls. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-13/banned-nvidia-chips-installed-at-china-data-center-linked-to-alice-huang), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/companies-linked-alice-huang-invested-deepseek), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261113/p7#a261113p7), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/chinese-ai-data-centers-still-specify-nvidia-chips-under-us-curbs/))

### LangChain Secures $300M Series C at $3B Valuation for Agent Governance
LangChain announced on November 13, 2026 that it raised $300 million in a Series C round at a $3 billion valuation. Existing investor CapitalG led the financing. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/langchain-secures-300m-series-c-at-3b-valuation-for-agent-governance/))
